messages:
mike_partnerships: Hey @olga_partner_ops and @luis_sales — CloudHarbor confirmed Balearic region in their marketplace today. Need to sync quotas, SKU availability, and announcement timing. :wave:
olga_partner_ops: Awesome. They said initial capacity: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (sku: ch-a100-small) + 20 T4-equivalents. Marketplace entitlement shows as 'pending' for our SKU (rwd-bal-1).
luis_sales: Customer demand forecast looks healthy — ~50 steady RPS for embeddings first month. Do we plan dedicated capacity or rely on burst spot?
eva_engineering: For latency SLOs we should aim for 2x redundancy per AZ. Recommend reserved/dedicated capacity for the first 6–8 weeks with spot fallback configured.
anna_infra: Agree. I'm starting a quota request. @deploy-bot please raise the marketplace entitlement ticket with CloudHarbor payload: ```{"product":"redwood-balearic","sku":"rwd-bal-1","requested_units":10,"region":"balearic"}```
deploy-bot: Ticket CH-4872 created: Marketplace entitlement request submitted to CloudHarbor partner ops. ETA 48h for initial review. https://tickets.internal/CH-4872
olga_partner_ops: CloudHarbor legal requires the PSA addendum signed before certifying our listing. @anna_gc_legal can you take a look? Link: https://go/redwood/legal/ch-psa-balearic
anna_gc_legal: I will review by EOD tomorrow. Heads-up: there's a paywall clause and a KMS clause to reconcile. We need to confirm customer-managed KMS flow before GA.
luis_sales: Private plan customers will require VPC + KMS support. Is that enabled in Balearic for our Private deployment?
eva_engineering: Private deployments are supported but partner must enable cross-account VPC peering in their AZs. Also we need to run a NVidia driver + CUDA smoke test during preflight.
olga_partner_ops: Ops contact at CloudHarbor is maria@cloudharbor.com. I'll schedule a handshake call Thu 09:00 PT and invite partner infra and NimbusSI.
mike_partnerships: Can we draft a joint announcement timeline? My proposal: internal preview -> partner PR -> external blog. Target GA: 2026-06-08, embargo until 2026-06-05. Thoughts? :calendar:
luis_sales: Need marketing assets and partner logo approvals. Marketing wants final approved copy + partner quote by 2026-05-25.
eva_engineering: We also need a perf matrix for the Balearic A10G variant (their mid-tier SKU). @anna_infra can you run perf runs for 512 tokens with batch sizes [1,4,16]? Post results to #eng-runtime and link back here.
anna_infra: Will run runs tomorrow morning and post artifacts. I'll include throughput and p99 latency.
olga_partner_ops: SI (NimbusSI) wants a deep link into our console for provisioning and a sample OAuth scope. @mike_partnerships can you share API contract?
mike_partnerships: Shared draft contract: https://go/redwood/api/contracts/balearic-provision-v1.md — ask NimbusSI to confirm scopes by Monday.
anna_gc_legal: Reminder: any joint announcement needs legal sign-off on partner mentions and quote usage. PR templates: https://go/redwood/comm-templates.
luis_sales: :thumbsup: I'll own partner sales enablement (week of 2026-05-30).
mike_partnerships: Quick checklist so we don't miss anything:
  1) PSA addendum signed (Anna GC)
  2) Marketplace entitlement approved (CH-4872)
  3) Quotas provisioned + infra ready (Anna Infra)
  4) Perf certs and driver smoke tests (Eng)
  5) SI hooks validated (NimbusSI)
  6) Marketing assets + embargo confirmed (Marketing)
Call Thu to confirm progress?
olga_partner_ops: ✅ Confirmed Thu 09:00 PT. I'll send calendar invites in 10m.
mike_partnerships: Thanks all — please drop any blocker updates in this thread before the call. :shipit:
